research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free review of shared mathematical prerequisites with original context and non-merge restrictions.

aliases.reason: The exact-sequence source requires arrows with matching source/target for consecutive compositions, and the epimorphism source requires composability a∘f and b∘f. The shared prerequisite is typed categorical composability, not exactness or epimorphism cancellation.

The independence-of-events formula P(A∩B) and the subspace-topology formula τ_A={A∩U} use the same binary set intersection. The measurable-event and open-subspace restrictions belong to their parents; the underlying intersection is not a new mathematical object.

The nil-ideal formulation invokes the property that each element has some positive power zero, exactly the nilpotence predicate in the reduced-ring formulation. Its commutative-ring assumption specializes the general associative-ring nilpotence prerequisite; 'locally nilpotent ideal' remains its own parent context.

Ordinary and exponential generating functions both define a real power-series domain D as the set of real z where the coefficient-weighted series converges. The coefficients differ (a_n versus a_n/n!), so the actual domains need not agree, but the power-series convergence-domain construction is the same prerequisite.

Splitting fields and irreducible-polynomial quotient fields each use a root α of a polynomial over a smaller field in an extension, meaning polynomial evaluation equals zero. Root multiplicity, splitting and field generation remain parent-specific.
